Separate success messages do not alter background wallet creation, custody, key control, or seed-phrase and configuration requirements.
The decision does not change which payment methods are available or selectable.
The source concerns referral-scenario success copy and does not change ETH payment enablement, swap execution, swap target, or refund currency.
Using separate success messages does not change the $15 mint price or its pricing commitments.
The modal messages describe existing commission and prize outcomes but do not change the underlying founder, affiliate, or prize-pool allocations.
